title: PURANI HAVELI | Bollywood Halloween ft. DJ ARJAV
description: Desibeatz x Brown Buoy present the 9th Annual PURANI HAVELI! Bollywood Halloween with DJ ARJAV, Oct 31, 10 PM–2 AM in San Jose.
long_description:
Desibeatz x Brown Buoy present the 9th Annual PURANI HAVELI! Bollywood Halloween with DJ ARJAV, Oct 31, 10 PM–2 AM in San Jose.

About this Event

DESIBEATZ x BROWN BUOY PRESENT
9TH ANNUAL PURANI HAVELI 🕯️
Some doors should stay closed. This Halloween, we’re opening them.
PURANI HAVELI returns to Downtown San Jose for a night of wicked looks, loud singalongs, and Bollywood after dark. Bring your crew, go all out with your costume, and make your Halloween entrance count.
WHAT TO EXPECT
🎧 DJ ARJAV taking over the decks
🔥 Bollywood favorites and dance floor anthems
🎭 Costumes encouraged—spooky, glamorous, or completely unexpected
EVENT DETAILS
📅 Saturday, October 31, 2026
🕙 10 PM–2 AM
📍 81 W Santa Clara St, San Jose
🔞 21+ | Valid government-issued photo ID required
TICKETS & VIP
🎟️ General Admission: $20
🍾 VIP Tables: $300
No free guestlist—secure your tickets in advance.
Lock in your tickets, assemble your crew, and dress like you belong in the Haveli.
Photography & Video Notice: Photos and videos may be captured during the event and used for promotional purposes.

NO REFUNDS
